n-m-e3-s2b-01.title: Samar da lamba tsakanin pizza ɗaya da pizza biyu ta amfani da rabo mai maiƙirari iri ɗaya
n-m-e3-s2b-01.topic: Rabo (rabo marar dacewa da rabo na raka’a, girman rabo: rabo tsakanin 1 da 2)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.goal: Bincika da misalai da dama lokacin da mai ƙididdigi na rabo mai maimaita ma’ana ya sa ya fi 1 amma ya yi ƙasa da 2, sannan ka faɗi inda rabo na iyaka yake.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.material: Ƙungiyar Seoa tana raba pizza da aka yanka zuwa ɓangarori masu girma iri ɗaya. Idan an raba pizza 1 daidai zuwa sassa 4, sashe ɗaya 1/4 na pizza ne. Ana rubuta sassa 3 a matsayin 3/4 pizza, sassa 5 kuma a matsayin 5/4 pizza. Ana kiran rabo mai maiƙididdigi mafi girma da maimaita ma’ana rabo marar dacewa.

n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.2: Ƙirga misalan sannan ka tabbatar ba a bar ko ɗaya ba, kuma ba a ƙirga wani fiye da sau ɗaya ba
n-m-e3-s2b-01.prereq.0: Karanta rabo a matsayin duka da ɓangare (3 daga cikin 4, da dai sauransu)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.prereq.1: San rabo marar dacewa da lambobi gauraye
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.prompt: An raba pizza 1 daidai zuwa sassa 4. Wanne daga cikin rabo na ƙasa ya fi pizza 1?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.hint.0: Zana hoto, raba pizza 1 zuwa sassa 4, sannan ka yi wa adadin sassan kowane zaɓi inuwa.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta adadin sassan pizza ɗaya da adadin sassan kowane zaɓi gefe da gefe.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.a: Sassa 3 ba su cika pizza ɗaya ba, amma wataƙila ka yi tunanin sun fi saboda ka kalli adadin sassan kawai.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani yana ɗaukar rabo daidai da pizza ɗaya a matsayin ‘fiye da pizza ɗaya’.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ya gano yanayin da adadin sassan ya fi adadin sassan da ke yin pizza ɗaya.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ya gan shi a matsayin ya fi yawa duk da cewa adadin sassan ƙanƙanta ne. Sassa nawa ne suke yin pizza ɗaya?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.explain: Pizza ɗaya sassa 4 ce. Sassa 5 pizza ɗaya ne (sassa 4) da ƙarin sashe 1, don haka ya fi pizza ɗaya. Sassa 4 daidai pizza ɗaya ne, sassa 3 ko 2 kuma sun yi ƙasa da pizza ɗaya.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi maimaita ma’ana daga 3 zuwa 9, sannan ka ƙirƙiri rabo marar dacewa a/b guda 4 dabam-dabam masu girma fiye da pizza ɗaya amma ƙasa da pizza biyu. (Maimaita ma’ana ita ce b, mai ƙididdigi kuma a ne.)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi maimaita ma’ana, sannan ka fara rubuta adadin sassan da aka raba pizza ɗaya zuwa gare su.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta adadin sassan pizza ɗaya da pizza biyu, sannan ka zaɓi mai ƙididdigi da yake tsakaninsu.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.2: Ga kowane rabo da ka ƙirƙira, bincika ta hanyar kwatanta mai ƙididdigi da adadin sassan pizza ɗaya da pizza biyu.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Maimaita ma’ana lambar halitta ce daga 3 zuwa 9.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Da fatan za a sa b ya zama lambar halitta daga 3 zuwa 9.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Mai ƙididdigi ya fi maimaita ma’ana girma, saboda haka ya fi pizza ɗaya.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ya fi pizza ɗaya. Mai ƙididdigi dole ya fi maimaita ma’ana (adadin sassan pizza ɗaya) girma.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Ya yi ƙasa da pizza biyu (sassa 2b).
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Dole ya yi ƙasa da pizza biyu. Mai ƙididdigi dole ya yi ƙasa da adadin sassan pizza ɗaya sau 2.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.explain: Idan maimaita ma’ana b ce, pizza ɗaya yana da sassa b. Idan mai ƙididdigi ya fi b kuma ya yi ƙasa da 2b, ya cika sharuɗɗan. Idan mai ƙididdigi ya yi daidai da b ko 2b, pizza ɗaya daidai ne ko pizza biyu daidai ne, saboda haka ba su shiga sharaɗin ‘fiye da kuma ƙasa da’ ba.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.prompt: Daga cikin rabon da maimaita ma’anarsa 6 ce, guda nawa ne gaba ɗaya suka fi pizza ɗaya amma suka yi ƙasa da pizza biyu?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta rabo masu maimaita ma’ana 6 a jere, tare da masu ƙididdigi daga 5 zuwa 13.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.1: Soke waɗanda suke daidai pizza ɗaya da daidai pizza biyu, sannan ka ƙirga waɗanda suka rage.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.a: Wannan tunani ya ƙirga ƙarin rabo ɗaya da yake a ɗaya daga cikin iyakokin, ko dai pizza ɗaya ko pizza biyu.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.b: Wannan tunani ya ƙirga har da rabo daidai da pizza ɗaya da pizza biyu.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.c: Wannan tunani ya rasa rabo ɗaya da ya cika sharuɗɗan. Rubuta masu ƙididdigi a jere, daga waɗanda suka fi 6.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.d: Wannan tunani ya cire iyakokin sannan ya ƙirga duk masu ƙididdigi da ke tsakaninsu.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.explain: Akwai guda 5, masu ƙididdigi 7, 8, 9, 10 da 11. 6/6 daidai pizza ɗaya ne, 12/6 kuma daidai pizza biyu ne, saboda haka ba a haɗa su ba.

n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, da farko ka kwatanta ko kimantawar Haram ta fi nauyi ko ta yi ƙasa da ainihin nauyin.
n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta lambobin da aka kimanta kusa da ainihin lambobin, sannan ka ƙirga sau nawa bambancin ya taru.

n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan tunani yana amfani da ƙimar da aka kimanta kamar ita ce ainihin nauyi. Duba nawa aka cire lokacin da aka mayar da shi 200.

n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Za a iya dogara da kimanta ta zagaye ƙasa zuwa 200 ko da yawan akwatuna nawa ne.
n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Yayin da yawan akwatuna ke ƙaruwa, adadin da aka cire yana taruwa sau da yawa. Ƙirga nawa zai tara idan akwatuna 3 ne.

n-m-e3-s2b-02.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa ba tare da sanin adadin lemon da ke akwai ba, nauyin lemu ɗaya ba zai gaya maka jimillar nauyin ba.

n-m-e3-s2b-02.s.s2.hint.2: Duba yadda nauyin lemu ke canzawa duk lokacin da kuka canza nauyin akwatin.

n-m-e3-s2b-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ne akwatin da lemu kowannensu ya kai aƙalla 100 g.
n-m-e3-s2b-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Jimillar ita ce 3 kg 400 g (3400 g).
n-m-e3-s2b-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Dole ne nauyaye biyun su haɗu su zama 3 kg 400 g. 1 kg daidai yake da 1000 g.

n-m-e3-s2b-02.s.s3.prompt: Jiwoo ta auna akwatin fanko, nauyinsa ya zama 800 g. Nawa ne nauyin lemu kaɗai?

n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan ma’aunin ƙasa iri ɗaya ne, kowace yanka tana da girma iri ɗaya, don haka yanki mai yanka da yawa (adadin sama) shi ne mafi girma.

n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Idan ma’aunin ƙasa iri ɗaya ne, girman kowace yanka ne kawai yake iri ɗaya, amma adadin yankan ya bambanta.

n-m-e3-s2b-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Za a iya gane wanda ya fi girma ta hanyar zana hoto kawai.
